messages:
Lena: Dropping a quick note  I just pushed an early 'refkit-mini' bundle for cloud partner enablement (tiny terraform modules + quickstart).
Marco: Nice, what's inside the bundle?
Lena: Minimal set: rwd-refkit/connector, rwd-refkit/network, a README with two profiles (cost/dev), manifest.json, and a scripts/preflight.sh.
Alyssa: Can the README include an explicit manifest/schema sample? Partners want machine-checkable fields for marketplace ingestion.
Lena: Yes  I'll add manifest fields: id, version, supported_deployments, tf_required, provider_lock_sha, smoke_acceptance.
Legal-Bot: Heads-up: avoid using partner product names or trademarks in public module names. Use generic descriptors.
Marco: Agreed. Also please include least-privilege IAM examples and a KMS/HSM note for Private deployments.
Alyssa: Add a short troubleshooting section for provider lockfile mismatches and a command to regenerate the lock with `terraform providers lock`.
Lena: Will do. I'll also include an assets/diagram.png (network + control-plane arrows) and a short SI-playbook in docs/si-runbook.md.
CI-Bot: Triggered: branch refkit-mini/v0.1 -> tf-fmt -> tflint -> tfsec -> smoke-ephemeral. ETA ~5m.
PartnerBot: Artifact uploaded to staging: s3://partners/refkit-mini/v0.1.tar.gz (sha256: 3f786850e387550fdab836ed7e6dc881).
Marco: For smoke acceptance, let's require: 1) terraform apply succeeds; 2) one inference call returns JSON schema; 3) teardown completes. Keep perf SLOs for v2.
Alyssa: Also include an example env var block for KMS creds and a short note about rotating keys every 90 days.
Lena: I'll open a PR after CI green. PR will include README, manifest, two example profiles, diagram PNG, and SI runbook.
CI-Bot: Smoke job #11021 completed: apply -> inference -> teardown PASSED. Logs: https://ci.redwood/logs/11021/refkit-mini.txt
Legal-Bot: Reviewed copy in README, minor wording tweak suggested on dataflow sentence.
Lena: Thanks  fixed the wording, pushed. Planning partner demo once PR merges. Who wants to run the demo runbook with me?
Marco: I can co-run. Schedule for next Tue 9am PT if docs merged by EOD Mon.
Alyssa: I'll prepare the SI checklist and the quick validation script for the demo.
Lena: Perfect  I'll post the PR link when ready. :thumbsup:
